items.title: Peter LaCaze Interview, 1972-01-27
items.q: Buddy Petit, yeah, I know him good, too.

ctx.x: You didn't think you needed a violin.

No, that's right. You couldn't... What they did, what they did, they depended on the trumpet and the clarinet to carry this thing along. Yeah. Yeah. Talking about trumpet, do you remember Buddy Petit? Buddy Petit, yeah, I know him good, too.
Never did work with him, but I know him good. You liked his way of playing?
